profile_text.body:
Supernormal is a software company that offers an AI product designed for agencies and client-facing teams. The company describes itself as providing an AI agent that connects meetings, documents, and email context to generate ready-to-use deliverables such as emails, slides, visuals, and documents based on client context.

The Supernormal product is categorized as a meetings and knowledge tool, with capabilities that include meeting notes, action item generation, CRM sync, and team productivity data. The site presents the product as a way for agencies to turn meeting content into client deliverables quickly.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
